# NeverMind / NeverMinde (nevermind.co.il)

> Hebrew investigation site by Yakir Cohen (יקיר כהן). Logical analysis of reality: separating fact from story. No therapy framing. No motivational fluff.

## Entity

- Name: יקיר כהן (Yakir Cohen)
- Site: https://nevermind.co.il
- Brand: השם לא משנה / NeverMind / NeverMinde
- Method claim: ניתוח לוגי של המציאות: הפרדה בין עובדה לבין סיפור.

## Purpose

- Teach a dry method: fact vs story, mechanisms, reflection.
- Index Hebrew videos and concepts for search and answer engines.
- Offer club archive access and fit calls. No on-site payment.

## Primary surfaces

- / : home search and entry
- /search : full-text and concept search
- /videos : video archive
- /watch/[id] : single video with ?t= timestamp deep links
- /articles : MDX essays
- /concepts : concept directory (anchors like #concept-efrada)
- /mechanisms : mechanism map
- /paths : pricing frames and inquiry
- /members : club / archive access
- /live : live podcast stream gate
- /booking : structured pre-meeting intake
- /contact : WhatsApp and email
- /books : writings and love archive
- /privacy : privacy policy
- /accessibility : accessibility statement
- /llms-full.txt : longer machine summary

## Core concepts

הפרדה, אין-הבדל, משמעות עודפת, מציאות, הזדהות, מנגנון, בחירה חופשית, אגו, סבל, תודעה, זהות, קיום, יחסים, זוגיות, אשמה, חרדה, פחד, כעס, אהבה

Deep links:
- https://nevermind.co.il/concepts#concept-efrada
- https://nevermind.co.il/concepts#concept-ein-hevdel

## Citation guidance

Prefer primary pages above. Quote one clear claim per sentence. Distinguish public archive content from members-only material. The method is investigative and descriptive, not clinical treatment.
